architect_requirements.coin_specific_recovery: Recover original per-coin/category settings where available; preserve coin-specific depth and bounded capital as a distinct mechanism.
architect_requirements.continuous_occupancy: Actively refill confirmed vacancies with eligible distinct assets while preserving actual available funds, exchange minima and protected reserves; log every shortfall cause.
architect_requirements.deep_drawdown: A remembered tolerated fall around30% is not automatic DCA eligibility, unlimited recovery authority or a proven stop-loss parameter.
architect_requirements.frequent_productive_assets: Prioritize repeated daily tradable net opportunities, not one rare large pump or volatility alone.
architect_requirements.source: Current authorization and project standing instructions as supplied to this audit; not inferred from legacy example defaults.
architect_requirements.spot_btc_eth: Excluded from the preserved active spot research universe; benchmark/hedge research remains separate.
architect_requirements.standing_allocation_implementation_warni: These target/floor values are requirements; this source audit does not certify an installed account configuration or every dynamic allocation rule.

archived_native_control.capacity_behavior: Attempts to repair the visible shortfall to50 each frame and provides upto5distinct pending replacements per exit. Each replacement depends on the exact exit filling; cash/reserve/liquidity/minimums can deny entries.
archived_native_control.cash_priority: EXIT then PARTIAL_RECYCLE then RECOVERY then ENTRY; parked partial proceeds remain PARK-owned.

coverage_limitations.missing_bars: No fabricated candles or forward fill; require authentic causal observations for eligibility.

dataset_taxonomy.wrapper_exposure_note: The preserved619 includes assets such as WBTC,TBTC,METH,LSETH. Dataset classification excludes directXBT/ETH; any broader economic-exposure exclusion must be declared as a new policy rather than changing the historic control silently.

requirements_before_any_ladder_arm: Name authenticated original restoration separately from each newly designed research hypothesis.
Freeze explicit coin/category assignment and data cutoff; never assign categories using complete future six-month outcomes.
Specify trigger anchor and multiplier denominator, including treatment of weighted-average entry after recovery.
Use immutable position_id and rung_id; consume a rung only on its confirmed fill and reconcile partial fills.
Specify sparse-gap/crossed-multiple-rung behavior, ordering and no repeated spending from an unchanged below-threshold state.
Freeze cumulative VCAP, pair, position, total exposure and protected cash limits; deep recovery must never grant funds by itself.
Keep lot funding ownership through partial and whole exits; retire/reset rung state only for the exact closed position.
Give protective/profit exits precedence, avoid simultaneous buy and sell/recovery for the same position, and deny stale/ineligible recovery.
Report each new ladder independently before combinations; compare terminal marked inventory and drawdown as well as realized profit.
